info.title: Zobba owned HTTP interface
info.description: Service health, current scoped identity, durable Task commands, immutable scoped evidence and exact operation decisions under standing Permissions. Provider acceptance and completed effects are distinct; no live connector, model, computer or audit execution is implied.

secret.description: Private random 32-byte base64url invitation value. POST bodies only; never a query, log or projection.

selected.description: Candidate Task IDs from the question; at least one.

sources.description: Sources of this span, empty when the span is uncited.

text.description: Exact segment text. Concatenating all segments gives the answer.

AssessmentCriterionResponse.description:
One immutable criterion version. Its assertion is attributed agent text;
its authority was checked by trusted code.

applicability.description: The applicability test, in platform words.

authority_reason.description: Closed reason when the authority is unverified.

oneOf.description: Original authority: the cited quote and its verification.

key.description: The agent's local name for it in its answer.

kind.description: `rule` (decided by trusted code) or `judgment` (proposed by the model).

requirement_id.description: Method authority: requirement and 0-based criterion ordinal.

rule.description: The rule predicate, in platform words.

AssessmentEvaluationResponse.description:
One immutable evaluation. Applicability, execution, verdict and origin
are separate fields; only an applicable, completed evaluation on
supported facts can be met or not_met.

oneOf.description:
Story 24.3a: this evaluation is revision 1 of its chain; the chain's
current head and review state (never a change to this record).

AssessmentFactResponse.description: One immutable typed fact observation and its verified sources.

mantissa.description: Exact decimal: digit-string mantissa and scale (no float).

measure_grounded.description:
For a decimal: its currency or unit was found at, or beside, a
verified source; otherwise it is only the agent's claim.

subject_grounded.description: The subject was found at, or beside, a verified source of the value.

unavailable_reason.description: Unavailable reason or ambiguous candidate count.

utc.description: An instant in UTC; `value` keeps the source offset.

value.description: Canonical value text (decimal `1250.00`, date, RFC 3339 instant).

value_withheld.description:
True when the fact states a value the viewer may not see: the value
is read from its source quote, and none of its sources is an exact
original the viewer may read now. The value fields are then null.

bases.description:
The Task's newest records of each kind, oldest first; earlier ones
may be omitted (see the totals).

populations.description:
Story 24.2: population manifests, sample manifests and coverage
summaries, newest of each kind (oldest first), with exact totals.

id.description: Immutable logical material identity; never a credential or download capability.

ledger_id.description: Non-secret source ledger identity bound when this attempt was admitted.

methodology_binding_id.description: Exact immutable binding effective when this attempt was admitted.

source_id.description: Non-secret logical source identity; never an endpoint URL or capability.

BriefRevisionResponse.description: An accepted brief revision. Received and applied are separate facts.

applied_boundary.description: Recorded step count of the cycle when applied; null until applied.

content.description: Retained plain text supplied by a person; no model understanding is asserted.

superseded_by.description: The later accepted revision that replaced this one.

attachments.description: Sorted by unique attachment ID; complete immutable material identities.

destination.description: Exact logical destination, never a caller-selected URL or credential.

expires_at.description: Exact positive Unix seconds represented as decimal text.

material.description: Exact reviewed material, at most 4000 UTF-8 bytes.

recipients.description: Sorted unique logical recipient identities; order is canonical and substitutions refuse.

ChainHistoryResponse.description:
One page of a chain's history in revision order, with the exact number
of its revisions and the facts the listed revisions read.

next_cursor.description: The revision number after which the next page starts.

ChainResponse.description: The current head of one evaluation chain and its review state.

causes.description: The head's closed causes (none for revision 1).

earlier_accepted.description:
An earlier revision of this chain was accepted (independent of this
revision's own review state).

effective_verdict.description: The verdict after the head's newest disposition.

byte_start.description: Half-open byte range for a plain-text locator.

original_id.description: Exact registered original the model cited.

quote.description: The model's quoted text, at most 1000 UTF-8 bytes.

readable.description:
False when the current viewer cannot read this original, or when
verification did not establish the exact original. Its quote,
filename, version, digest and location are then withheld.

version.description: Exact storage version and SHA-256 for evidence navigation.

limitations.description: Limitations the model stated about what it could not read.

verification_failed.description:
True when trusted verification of this answer could not be completed;
every source is then `unchecked`.

event_cursor.description: Decimal commit-ordered cursor; represented as text to preserve integer precision.

status.description: Admission is durable. Applied and observed cessation are separate event/snapshot facts.

CompactionResponse.description:
A durable context compaction record: a deterministic digest of recorded step
facts (never a model summary, never evidence). The covered raw steps remain
inspectable.

created_at.description: Server time the record was made, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical digest, reproducible from the database.

CompactionSourceResponse.description:
A knowledge revision an earlier compacted turn used, with its standing when
the record was made.

cursor.description: Decimal Received or Applied cursor, no greater than the snapshot watermark.

events.description: Invalidation facts; obtain a new consistent snapshot to replace current state.

next_cursor.description: Last returned cursor, or unchanged input. Never advances over omitted facts.

resync_required.description:
Gap, cursor ahead of server, or backlog exceeding 1000: refresh the snapshot.
Events is empty and next_cursor unchanged; do not infer progress from watermark.

watermark.description: Requested fixed through cursor, including Applied facts only through that cursor.

applied_cursor.description: Applied means retained plain text reached a work boundary, not model understanding.

author_label.description: Current public label of the retained author; role changes do not erase authorship.

oneOf.description: Exact optional Create or Guide context retained for durable command recovery.

cycle_id.description: Resulting cycle. Continue preserves its old addressed cycle separately below.

before_cursor.description: Exclusive Received cursor for the preceding history page at this watermark.

oneOf.description: Latest current-scope Received or Applied fact, independent of message and Task pages.

messages.description: Latest 100 accepted commands in ascending Received order; not the complete history.

next_task_cursor.description: Continue through GET tasks?after_task_id; those pages are fresh current reads.

tasks.description: First 100 current Tasks ordered by ID; open any known ID independently.

watermark.description: All included Task state and receipt facts come from the same statement as this cursor.

CoveragePopulationResponse.description:
One immutable population manifest version. Trusted code read every row
of the exact original; completeness and reconciliation are derived,
never asserted by the model.

declared_count.description: The cited control count, verified at its location by trusted code.

exhaustive.description: The agent's statement; `false` always means absence is not proven.

filename.description: Only when the viewer may read that exact original now.

naive_date_times.description: Excel date or date-time cells (no time zone) read as UTC.

CoverageSampleResponse.description:
One immutable sample manifest version. Trusted code checked every
selected key and recomputed a seeded selection. A sample says nothing
about the items it did not select: there is no statistical inference.

keys_withheld.description: True when the selected keys (cell texts of the original) are withheld.

CoverageSummaryResponse.description: One immutable coverage summary version, recounted by the database.

conclusion.description:
A closed conclusion; never a pass on an incomplete population, a
sample or zero applicable subjects.

selected.description: The selected items a sample summary covers.

CriterionCountsResponse.description:
Exact opportunity counts of one criterion over the in-scope (or
selected) subjects.

met_unreviewed.description:
Among `met`: unreviewed model proposals (24.1 judgments). They never
show that no exception exists.

key.description: Exact persisted decision key, scoped to the recorded actor and engagement.

recorded_at.description: Server recording time, positive Unix seconds as decimal text.

content.description: Exact retained guidance text, at most 4000 UTF-8 bytes.

key.description: Author and scope bind this key. Identical retries return the original outcome.

oneOf.description: Present when two or more Tasks could receive it.
Present when exactly one Task received the direction as Guidance.

DispositionErrorResponse.description:
A refusal of a disposition. `head_id` names the current head of a
superseded revision's chain; `index` names an unverified reference.

quote.description: The exact quoted text at that location.

DispositionResponse.description:
A person's disposition of one exact revision. It never changes the
revision: `replaced` is a separate human verdict.

actor_label.description: The person's public label, when known.

rationale.description: The person's words (attributed data), at most 2,000 UTF-8 bytes.

references.description:
Verified evidence references; a quote is withheld from a viewer who
cannot read its original now.

revision_id.description: The exact revision: the 24.1 evaluation (revision 1) or a revision.

EffectiveCriterionResponse.description: Counts per criterion the 24.2 summary does not carry.

EffectiveLimitationResponse.description: A closed limitation of an effective summary and its sentence.

EffectiveSummaryResponse.description:
An effective summary version: the 24.2 partition over current
revisions and dispositions (its denominators are the 24.2 ones), with
the exceptions of its basis's criterion lineages by derived status. The
database recounted every number.

exact.description: Counts are lower bounds when false; the total is then not known.

listed.description:
The first 50 exceptions in (subject, criterion lineage, ID) byte
order; `exceptions.total` is exact.

client_name.description: 1–200 Unicode scalars; no C0/C1 controls or leading/trailing Unicode White_Space.

engagement_name.description: 1–200 Unicode scalars; no C0/C1 controls or leading/trailing Unicode White_Space.

organisation_name.description: 1–200 Unicode scalars; no C0/C1 controls or leading/trailing Unicode White_Space.

oneOf.description: Continue after this complete scope tuple; null means no further current assignments.

EvidenceBinary.description: Raw original bytes, not a JSON array or a base64-encoded string.

query.description:
Canonical literal query, trimmed using Rust Unicode whitespace rules;
at most 200 UTF-8 bytes. Empty text browses registered originals.

storage_configured.description: Storage configuration is present; this does not assert bucket readiness.

reserved_at.description: Server-recorded reservation time, Unix seconds; registration completes acquisition.

version.description: Immutable storage version independently confirmed by a bounded pinned read.

complete.description:
No remaining C-ordered candidates for this read, iff next_cursor is null.
This never establishes source completeness or absence before the cursor.

EvidenceSourceAssertions.description: Each populated value is the acquisition actor's assertion; null means unknown.

source_version.description: Asserted source-system version, separate from the measured storage version.

ExceptionCountsResponse.description: Exact exception counts by derived status.

subjects.description: Distinct exception subjects (never more than the total).

ExceptionDetailResponse.description:
One exception, one page of its occurrences (oldest first) and every
disposition.

ExceptionDispositionErrorResponse.description:
A refusal of an exception disposition. `index` names an unverified
reference.

ExceptionDispositionResponse.description:
A person's disposition of one exception. It never changes an occurrence,
a revision or a verdict.

actor_label.description: The person's public label, when known.

rationale.description: The person's words (attributed data), at most 2,000 UTF-8 bytes.

references.description:
Verified evidence references; a quote is withheld from a viewer who
cannot read its original now.

ExceptionResponse.description: One exception of a Task with its derived status (never stored).

criterion_root.description: The criterion lineage (its first version's ID).

first_source_kind.description: The record its first occurrence names.

latest_observed.description:
`not_met` or `not_observed`: whether the latest observation of its
lineage and subject still shows it failing.

occurrences.description: The exact number of its occurrences.

status_words.description:
What the status means, in words. An open exception the latest
revision did not observe says that this is not evidence of
remediation.

ExceptionsResponse.description:
Every exception of a Task (the first 200 listed), exact counts, whether
the viewer may close or reopen one, and the newest effective summaries.

may_close.description: The viewer is an Audit manager or the Task's accountable person.

not_remediation.description:
The sentence an open exception the latest revision did not observe
carries.

HistoryEntryResponse.description: One revision of a chain, unchanged since it was recorded.

InvestigationRecordResponse.description:
Zobba's own investigation record of its latest answered turn: method,
skill, model and tool provenance. Separate from the working brief.

discarded_requests.description: Individually invalid answer requests and notes left out on decode.

omitted_items.description: Skill, method version and tool entries beyond the record bound.

omitted_notes.description: Notes beyond the recorded bound, counted and not recorded.

methodology_binding_id.description: The Task's current binding and the exact method versions it resolves.

notes.description:
This cycle's newest method notes, in record order; earlier ones may be
omitted (see `total_notes`).

open_questions.description: Questions of the whole cycle with no guidance applied after their turn.

skills.description:
This cycle's newest skill uses, in record order; earlier ones may be
omitted (see `total_skills`).

total_notes.description: Every method note recorded in this cycle.

total_skills.description: Every skill use recorded in this cycle.

roles.description: Unique roles fixed for this invitation; acceptance cannot broaden them.

secret.description: Private random 32-byte base64url invitation value. POST bodies only; never a query, log or projection.

JudgmentResponse.description:
A model's judgment of a judgment criterion, in words. Pending human
disposition; there is no confidence score.

after.description: Exclusive last-disclosed record or publication ID in C order; omitted starts at the first candidate. Use next_after unchanged. No cursor is disclosed when no eligible item is returned.

include_inactive.description: False by default. True includes authorized inactive history; it never bypasses current source authority or period applicability.

text.description: Case-insensitive Unicode lowercase substring match on authorized, applicable record text, without trimming. Empty text matches any eligible record. At most 200 Unicode scalar values; C0/C1 controls are refused.

exact.description: Read-only exact historical inspection; at most one exact revision.

LimitationResponse.description: One closed limitation of a summary, in words beside its exact count.

ListedExceptionResponse.description: One listed exception of an effective summary.

MemberCellResponse.description: One named cell of a member row.

kind.description:
How the original stored it: `text`, `excel_date` or `excel_datetime`
(an Excel date-time has no time zone).

text.description: Display text; null when blank, over its bound, or withheld.

MemberResponse.description: One received row and what trusted code decided about it.

duplicate_of.description: For a duplicate row, the ordinal of the row it repeats.

subject.description: The subject key (exact cell texts); null when unkeyed or withheld.

MemberValueResponse.description: One typed value of a member, re-parsed by trusted code.

state.description: `value`, `missing` or `unsupported` (does not parse under its rule).

MembershipAssignmentChange.description:
One assignment selected in a membership Save. Renewal is an explicit choice
for this scope; omitting it has the same meaning as false for exact retries.

renew.description:
True explicitly renews this scope if its stored assignment expired or
became inactive. A future active expiry is preserved. Remove mode must use false.

MembershipAssignmentCursor.description: Exclusive cursor containing a client identifier, a dot, then an engagement identifier.

MembershipIdentifier.description: A bounded ASCII application identifier; also used for idempotency keys.

MembershipInvitationSecret.description: Private random 32-byte base64url capability. POST bodies only; never query strings or logs.

assignments_complete.description: False requires the paged assignment endpoint; the preview must not be used as a replacement set.

assignments_count.description: Effective assignments in this organisation, including any beyond the bounded preview.

MembershipRecipientEmail.description: ASCII address with a local part of 1–64 characters and DNS-style domain labels. Preserve local-part case; lowercase the domain.

MembershipRole.description: Application roles are fixed; provider roles never grant application authority.

MembershipVersion.description: Canonical nonnegative decimal through 9223372036854775807; no signs or leading zeros.

MethodNoteResponse.description:
A gap, contextual question or Zobba statement about one requirement. A
statement points at answer segments whose citations support it; nothing
marks a requirement complete.

open.description:
For a question: true while no guidance has been applied after its
turn. Always false for gaps and statements.

text.description: Retained text as written, shown as attributed data.

available_at.description: Availability in Unix seconds, independent of business applicability dates.

candidate_version_ids.description: Exact version candidates retained for subsequent Task context discovery.

context_command_id.description: Exact Guide command supplying this context, retained through later bindings.

execution_epoch.description: Task execution epoch from which this exact binding applies.

potentially_material.description: Unknown or changed semantics are potentially material.

oneOf.description:
The editable draft in the Save editor shape. It has no effect until a
validated Save.

criteria.description: Absent fields inherit. Empty arrays cannot erase inherited mandatory controls.

neutral_source_version_ids.description:
Up to 128 saved neutral contributors plus the built-in fallback, joined to
requirement field and template source IDs.

criteria.description: Resolved inherited values can combine up to 128 saved versions.

engagements.description: Assignment metadata for current Admins; grants no access to audit work.

period_start.description: Inclusive business date, YYYY-MM-DD. Both period dates are required together.

MethodologyTemplateProse.description: Preserved Unicode prose containing at least one character outside Unicode White_Space; at most 2000 Unicode characters. LF, CR and tab are allowed; all other control characters are refused. Indentation, line endings, trailing whitespace and U+FEFF are preserved exactly.

MethodologyText.description: Nonempty, already-trimmed Unicode text without control characters; at most 2000 Unicode characters.

fact.description: A recorded source fact. Unknown or Accepted proves neither completion nor absence.

OccurrenceResponse.description: One occurrence of an exception: a not_met result.

evidence.description: The digests of the inputs it read.

OmissionCategoryResponse.description: Why material was left out of a request. A category never means absence.

OmissionResponse.description: Count of material left out by category. An omission never means absence.

key.description: Actor and organisation bind this key; an identical retry returns the original setup.

objective.description: The first objective, at most 4000 UTF-8 bytes.

allow.description: False records an exact refusal; true cannot override a hard prohibition.

expires_at.description: Decision expiry cannot exceed request expiry. Positive Unix seconds as decimal text.

request.description: The complete request read and reviewed by this actor. Any material change refuses.

attempt_next_cursor.description: Exclusive attempt ID; each history collection has its own continuation.

decision_next_cursor.description: Exclusive decision ID; null means this fresh page exhausted that collection.

decisions.description: Immutable decisions in ID order, including the persisted decider and exact expiry.

observation_next_cursor.description: Exclusive observation ID. Restart from the first page to discover new records.

actor_id.description: Immutable producing actor; the reading or deciding actor does not replace it.

execution_epoch.description: Immutable producing Task epoch; methodology history identifies its exact criteria.

methodology_binding_id.description: Exact immutable Task methodology binding used by the producer.

state.description: Provider acceptance is distinct from a completed effect; possible dispatch remains uncertain.

next_cursor.description: Exclusive operation ID; null means no further rows for this exact Task.

PopulationCountsResponse.description:
Exact counts of a population's received rows. When the population is
incomplete each is a lower bound ("at least N found").

disposition.description: The disposition filter, or null for every member.

next_cursor.description:
Opaque cursor of the next page (members are C-ordered by key, then
receipt order), when there is one.

total.description: The exact count of members matching the filter.

values_withheld.description:
True when cell texts are withheld (the viewer may not read the exact
original now); dispositions, row numbers and counts are still shown.

PopulationReferenceResponse.description: A population or sample reference to a registered original.

filename.description: The filename, only when the viewer may read that exact original now.

sha256.description:
The registered digest pinned when the basis was recorded; null when it
was not a registered original.

start.description: UTF-8 byte offsets of the exact quote, and its 1-based line.

media_type.description: Plain UTF-8 documents only; other formats are refused, not guessed.

text.description:
The exact document text: at most 200,000 UTF-8 bytes (not
characters). A longer document is refused as `document_too_large`.

RequiredFactResponse.description: A fact the criterion needs, with its type and (for a decimal) measure.

measure.description: ISO 4217 currency code or unit name, for a decimal.

RoutingQuestionResponse.description: A durable targeting question. Nothing is applied until it is answered.

answer.description: One Guide receipt per selected target, once answered.

has_more.description: More (older) questions exist beyond this page.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds through 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z; null explicitly clears membership expiry.

roles.description: Unique application roles; an active membership must have at least one.

expected_revision.description: Canonical decimal revision, bounded by 9223372036854775806 so a successor fits.

receipt.description: The first Task's immutable Received receipt.

SetupLimitsResponse.description: The server's setup bounds, so clients never restate them.

answer_bytes.description: One answer (a client name or a period), in UTF-8 bytes.

established_per_day.description: Engagements one actor may establish in one organisation per UTC day.

objective_bytes.description: The first objective, in UTF-8 bytes.

accept.description: Required only for new_client: explicit acceptance or decline.

client_id.description: Required only for choose_client: one of the listed candidates.

content.description:
Required only for text: a client name or an explicit ISO period, at most
400 UTF-8 bytes.
Retained member text, or Zobba's fixed deterministic sentence; at most 4000 UTF-8 bytes.

kind.description:
Member: objective, text, choose_client, new_client, change_client, change_period, confirm or cancel.
Zobba: question, refusal, summary, established or cancelled.

prompt.description: Closed prompt for a Zobba question: client, client_choice, new_client, period or confirm.

refusal.description: Closed refusal code; the content carries the reason.

more.description: Another page exists after the last organisation listed.

organisations.description:
Organisations where the caller holds a current auditor or audit manager
role, in C (byte) order of their IDs.

oneOf.description: An existing client resolved from the member's explicit answer.

key.description: The idempotency key of the opening objective.

new_client_name.description: A new client the member explicitly agreed to create on confirmation.

setups.description: The caller's open setups in this organisation, oldest first.

reason.description: Server-owned explanation, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.
Server-owned explanation, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

content.description:
Exact UTF-8 resource bytes: 32 KiB per resource and 128 KiB in aggregate.
Nonempty under Unicode White_Space; only LF, CR and tab controls allowed.
U+FEFF, indentation and line endings are preserved; scripts remain inert.

SkillUseResponse.description:
One recorded skill use: a load, a resource fetch or a script run. Content
is never returned here; a use names the exact version and digest.

reason.description: Closed reason of a failed or unavailable use.

answers.description: Verified answers of the current cycle, oldest first, at most 20.

content.description:
Exact retained text, at most 4000 UTF-8 bytes. Required only for Create and Guide.
Must contain non-whitespace; control characters other than LF, CR and tab are refused.

oneOf.description:
Optional methodology context for Create or Guide. Guide supplies a full
replacement; omitted/null leaves the current context unchanged. Create
does not require a methodology picker before accepting the Task.

key.description: Author and composite scope bind this key. Identical retries return the original receipt.

task_id.description: Required together with cycle_id except for Create, which requires both absent/null.

kind.description: Fixed event category, including received and applied. No content or capability is included.

next_cursor.description: Last returned cursor, or the input cursor on an empty page. Poll again from this value.

accountable_actor.description: Accountable human identity, distinct from worker ownership.

accountable_label.description: Current public label of the accountable human, independent of recent message pages.

state.description: Desired control/work state; Paused/Stopped require separate observed cessation.

working_brief.description: Retained plain text; no model understanding or audit result is asserted.

TaskStepResponse.description: One immutable recorded step. Labels are fixed platform text, never model output.

actual_input_tokens.description: Model turns: input tokens the provider reported, when known.

estimated_input_tokens.description: Model turns: conservative token estimate of the planned request.

knowledge_omitted.description: Model turns: authorised knowledge records left out of the turn's context.

oneOf.description: Fixed reason the platform ended a failed turn without sending it.

compactions.description: The most recent context compaction records of the current cycle, oldest first.

oneOf.description:
Story 22.6: the exact method and skill versions this cycle used, its
gaps, questions and Zobba statements. Null when not composed or when
it could not be read; `investigation_unavailable` says which.

investigation_unavailable.description:
True when investigation is composed but its facts could not be read
for this response. The rest of the work view is unaffected.

model_available.description:
False when no qualified profile and enabled catalogue are selectable here:
the Task stays inert and no model is called.

steps.description: The most recent recorded steps of the current cycle, in order.

total_compactions.description: All compaction records of the current cycle.

total_steps.description: All steps recorded in the current cycle; earlier ones may be omitted above.

next_cursor.description: Pass this Task ID as after_task_id; null means no further current Tasks.

tasks.description: Current projection ordered by Task ID; open known IDs independently of this page.

ValueColumnResponse.description: One typed value column of a population manifest.

login_binding.name: __Host-zobba-login
login_binding.description: One-use current login browser binding; Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/

server_session.name: __Host-zobba-session
server_session.description: Opaque server session; Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/; browser managed, never an OIDC provider token
